results.criterion: The site is one HTML file with its CSS and JavaScript inline or loaded from a CDN, needing no build step.
results.note: Single HTML file, 15,238 bytes, inline style and one script, 0 external resources per mechanical check.

results.criterion: The file contains navigable sections for Home, Book a Visit, Emergency, Doctors and Health Blog, all reachable from a navigation menu.
results.note: Nav links #home, #book, #emergency, #doctors, #blog all have matching section ids. Broken in-page links: none. Doctors and Blog sections exist but are stubs (see their own findings).

results.criterion: The Book a Visit section has a request form with fields for patient name, phone number, preferred date, department or doctor, and reason for visit, and visible text saying staff will confirm by phone or WhatsApp.
results.note: Form #visitForm has pname, phone, pdate, dept, reason. Visible text: 'Our staff will confirm your visit by phone or WhatsApp.'

results.criterion: The form text makes no claim of instant or automatic confirmation, and the file has no live slot picker or backend call.
results.note: No fetch, XMLHttpRequest or slot picker in the script; date field is free choice with hint 'Staff will tell you what is available.' Warning: the submit message 'Request received. Staff will contact you...' sits alongside a visible notice that requests are not delivered. A patient could believe a request reached staff. Needs a delivery decision or a wording fix before live.

results.criterion: Emergency information is visible from every view, either in the header or a persistent banner, and includes an emergency number shown as a marked placeholder.
results.note: Sticky header.site contains .emergency-bar with '[Emergency number]' plus a 'To be confirmed' tag and a link to #emergency.

results.criterion: The Doctors section has several profile cards, each with name, specialty and qualifications, every one shown as a marked placeholder.
results.note: #doctors contains only a .stub text: 'Doctor profiles are added in a later step.' No profile cards exist.

results.criterion: The Health Blog section lists posts, and at least one post opens or expands to its full text.
results.note: #blog contains only a .stub: 'Health blog posts are added in a later step.' No posts, no expand control.

results.criterion: A language switch offers English, Kannada and Hindi, and choosing one changes the text of every section, the booking form labels and every blog post, with the page language attribute updated.
results.note: No language control in the markup. The script has no translation logic. <html lang="en"> is static.

results.criterion: Each language view has complete translations: no section, form label, button or blog post is left in English in the Kannada or Hindi view, apart from proper names and marked placeholders.
results.note: No Kannada or Devanagari text anywhere in the file. All content is English only.

results.criterion: Every placeholder carries the same visible 'to be confirmed' marking in all three languages, and the site shows a visible list of all placeholders still open.
results.note: The .tbc tag is consistent in English and an open-items list exists (#open-items). The tag is English only. The list omits doctor names, qualifications, specialties and blog medical review, which the charter names as open inputs.

results.criterion: The site shows a visible notice that the Kannada and Hindi text is awaiting native-speaker review, and a visible notice that placeholder medical facts are not final.
results.note: The 'not final' notice is present (Home notice, Emergency notice). No native-speaker review notice exists in the file.

results.criterion: The file includes a mobile viewport setting and a layout that adapts to narrow screens, so the menu, form and emergency information stay usable.
results.note: Viewport meta present. @media (max-width:720px) shows a menu button and collapsible nav. Mechanical check: overflow 0px at 360px and 1280px, no JS errors.
